services.name: Kayak & Paddleboard
services.desc: Don't leave Glacier National Park without getting on Lake McDonald. As the pioneers who first brought paddleboards to the park, Glacier Outfitters offers the ultimate way to experience this crystal-clear alpine icon. Whether you choose a kayak or a SUP, it's a bucket-list experience you can't miss! Book for 9:30 AM to catch the lake at its calmest. Early morning offers those famous glass-like reflections. If you can't make it then, stop by the shop, and we'll get you launched whenever you arrive! Cast from shore or fish right from your kayak or paddleboard - no license needed in the park! For a stable and effortless paddle, our Ocean Brand kayaks are the premier choice for any lake

services.name: Fishing Rod
services.desc: You do not need a Montana state fishing license to fish within Glacier National Park boundaries. Just bring a valid park pass and you're good to go! Our staff can help you understand the boundary lines and current regulations. Pick up your fishing rod at our Yurt in Apgar Village, right inside Glacier National Park. Whether you're planning a relaxing afternoon on Lake McDonald or heading deeper into the heart of the park, Glacier Outfitters has you covered. blurb: Glacier Outfitters rents high-end, well-maintained gear for adventures in Glacier National Park. They offer rentals for bikes, kayaks, paddleboards, bear spray, hiking and camping gear, and fishing rods. They have two convenient locations: Apgar Village inside the park and Glacier Park International Airport for gear pickup.
